revisions.note: Established against a 4.20.0.315 client. Whether any of it holds for earlier versions is untested.

cipher.name: Blowfish
cipher.note: There is no padding. Trailing bytes that do not fill a block travel unchanged, so a payload shorter than one block is never enciphered at all.

base.name: ENet
base.note: Stock ENet does not interoperate. The header below replaces the stock one, and the constants replace stock values. Everything else, including reliability, sequencing and fragmentation, is stock behaviour.

header.name: unknown
header.note: Purpose undetermined. The client emits 28 68 bd eb invariantly, across sessions and regardless of the match key or player. It does not check what it receives here: a server writing four unrelated bytes is accepted. Removing the field breaks the connection, so the width matters and the content does not.

header.name: sessionId
header.note: A server MUST echo the value the client supplied when it connected. Sending a different value makes the client discard every packet, silently, with no error and no disconnection. The connection then dies of retransmission.

bits.name: peerId
bits.note: 127 marks a peer the transport has not assigned yet, which is what a connecting client sends.

bits.name: sentTimeFlag
bits.note: Set when the header carries a sent time.

header.name: sentTime
header.note: Milliseconds since the connection opened. Big endian, unlike every message field.

constants.name: maximumPeerId
constants.note: Follows from the peer id occupying seven bits.

constants.name: maximumTransmissionUnit
constants.note: The client asks for this when it connects. A ceiling on each end and the smaller of the two governs, so a server that leaves the stock ceiling in place still settles here. Whether a server may leave it alone is untested.
